sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Stabilize Business is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I told you the driver knows the right paths! That's where I'll send the shipment, although I don't have time for that at present. First I have to deal with those who killed my couriers. I already found the culprits, so now it's for Ragman to send his regards. I can't do anything to help the driver until this matter is handled. That's why I suggest you take care of it. Quicker you start, quicker you finish."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 7 Scavs in one raid on Ground Zero
- Survive and extract from the location

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +24,100 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.03
- 124,000 Roubles
  - 130,200 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 142,600 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× IOTV Gen4 body armor (Assault Kit, MultiCam)
"That's great! Now there is nothing to interfere with my operations, and we can think about expansion. For now, I need to figure out how to prepare for the BTR coming under my roof. Just be patient for a little longer."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to eliminate 7 Scavs on Ground Zero in a single raid and survive.
